The structure of Zr2Ti8Cu12 (ZrTi4(Cu3)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements and Ti centers with 14 neighbors, while Zr centers have 20 neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 22 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Cu 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Cu and Ti 14-vertex polyhedra.
